reviews.comment: Dave is by far the best professor I've had with an elective class. Not only does he care for his students, he brings his experience to the classroom. He's super chill and wants you to succeed. Be sure to ask him about his crawfish boil, it's the best party of the year.

David is by far the most caring prof in the department. He held review sessions on days we didn't have class (like a reading day) but he always bought us either pizza or sandwiches to make up for it. Very relaxed grading because he only cares about making sure everyone in the class takes away the things that are needed in the industry.
